GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (17 Sep 46) IPS
(SCAPIN-1210)
APO 500
17 September 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Release of SATOMI, Hajime.
1. SATOMI, Hajime, incarcerated in Sugamo Prison on 1 March 1946 was released unconditionally on 17 September 1946.
2. The Imperial Japanese Government will therefore make the proper notations in its records.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
